svg.title: A Linux-capable LiteX SoC with the ecosystem cores
svg.desc: A Linux-capable LiteX SoC on the Digilent Arty A7. Inside the FPGA: a VexRiscv (linux variant, MMU) with its instruction and data buses on the main bus, the ROM with the BIOS, the SRAM, the CSR bridge, and the cores added by the target: LiteDRAM (add_sdram) with its L2 cache and the DDR3 PHY driving the board's DDR3 chip, LiteEth (add_ethernet) with the MII PHY to the Ethernet transceiver of the board, LiteSDCard (add_sdcard) with its DMAs to the SD card slot, LiteSPI (add_spi_flash) to the configuration flash, the UART, timer, XADC, LEDs and GPIOs. Each core brings a BIOS command, a boot method, a Linux driver.

g.font-family: Calibri, Carlito, 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
g.text: Main bus: Wishbone 32-bit, shared, 1 MHz timeout
masters: cpu_bus0, cpu_bus1, sdcard_block2mem, sdcard_mem2block · slaves: rom, sram, main_ram, ethmac_rx/tx, spiflash, csr
